description: Check the progress of one page scan by report ID. Returns its status (queued, processing, complete or failed), a progress percentage when known, and which tool to call next. Use it when analyze_website returned a report ID before the scan finished, or after you started a scan with wait=false. Poll every few seconds, not in a tight loop. For a whole-site run started with start_site_analysis, call get_fix_plan instead. Returns an error if the report ID is unknown. Read-only. Free: does not use a credit.

report_id.description: Report ID (UUID) returned by analyze_website, for the scan to check

name: check_status
title: Check scan progress
